definition: the first version from which copies are made
description: A record pressing factory. A young woman in a navy work coat and white cotton gloves lifts a large metal tape reel high above her head and looks up at it, then lowers it and holds it in front of her, looking at it and speaking, while a big crowd of workers watches from the back of the hall. Beside her a young man in ear defenders works a pressing machine. Black vinyl records run along a conveyor, tall stacks of white sleeves stand nearby, and an open tape case lies on a trolley.

taps.phrase: to lift a tape reel overhead
